title: Onboard and Troubleshoot Windows Event Logs
track: Forwarders, Deployment Server, and Heavy Forwarders
objectives: Onboard and Troubleshoot Windows Event Logs
Verify actual configuration, delivery and resulting operational behavior.

tasks.instruction: This isolated attempt starts paused. Use Forwarder Management to inspect clients/apps/classes, or Terminal SSH from the bastion. Linux UF: ssh splunk@lab-lnx-0001. Automation: ssh svc_ansible@ansible01 then cd ~/splunk-automation. Administrative changes and packages are entirely simulated.

The AAA_v7_windows deployment app disables WinEventLog://Security. Use Forwarder Management Apps to load its local/inputs.conf and enable the channel while retaining index wineventlog, sourcetype v7_windows, renderXml=true and EventID blacklist 4662,5156. Publish and advance time. The fixture contains an explicit teaching queue of three XML events, including one denied event; this is not native Windows remote execution. Search for v7-win- and verify exactly two persisted records and their EventIDs.

After the required activation, select the client in Forwarder Management and use Advance simulation 60 seconds. Inspect btool/forwarding output and independent Search as required. Record the evidence answer; an answer alone cannot complete the exercise.

hints: Distinguish staged source, published catalog, downloaded app and running configuration.
Use a narrow target and the component that owns the change. Inspect failures before retrying.

references.purpose: Predict changes, apply and verify idempotency

checks.label: Security channel is active on the actual Windows client
Verify actual forwarder lifecycle and delivery
Independent search finds only the explicit teaching records

setup.text:
[global]
restartSplunkd = false

[serverClass:all_deploymentclient]
whitelist.0 = *

[serverClass:all_deploymentclient:app:org_all_deploymentclient]

[serverClass:lab_outputs]
whitelist.0 = lab-lnx-*
whitelist.1 = lab-win-*

[serverClass:lab_outputs:app:org_lab_outputs]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:lab_hf_outputs]

[serverClass:lab_hf_outputs:app:org_lab_hf_outputs]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:linux_servers]
whitelist.0 = lab-lnx-*

[serverClass:linux_servers:app:org_linux_servers_inputs]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:win_servers]
whitelist.0 = lab-win-*

[serverClass:win_servers:app:org_win_inputs]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:linux_all]
whitelist.0 = *-lnx-*

[serverClass:linux_all:app:Splunk_TA_nix]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:v7_canary]
whitelist.0 = lab-win-0002

[serverClass:v7_canary:app:AAA_v7_windows]
restartSplunkd = true

questions.prompt: How many teaching events remain after the EventID blacklist?

feedback.success: Verified real simulated source, delivery and operational outcomes.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect component scope, activation, actual phone-home, latest run and independent search results.
